title: Design System: Drishti ATM Forensic Review

record.purpose: Hashes, event identifiers, and timestamp-like machine values.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Softly separate evidence and summary panels from the canvas.

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Keep transient toast feedback legible above content.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button, navigation, and control state changes.

motion.name: page-entry
motion.purpose: Subtle transition into a workspace view.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident action for the main workflow.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #173954; border-radius: 5px; color: #fff; background: #173954; font: 600 11px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { background: #204b6c; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d59a45; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Evidence Input
components.description: Compact field for times and case references.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 36px; width: 220px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd3d9; border-radius: 5px; color: #1d2d3b; background: #fff; font: 400 12px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #bd7d2d; outline: 3px solid #d59a45; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #72818d; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Rail link with a clear active marker.
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 42px; width: 220px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: #c3ced7; background: #0c2236; text-align: left; font: 500 12px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav:hover, .ds-nav:focus-visible { color: #fff; background: #1b3c58; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d59a45; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: Quiet container for a reviewed candidate or record.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 260px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #dfe3e5; border-radius: 7px; color: #1d2d3b; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(16, 37, 54, .06); font: 400 12px/1.45 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #536575; font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Local Status Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 26px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #d2e3dd; border-radius: 4px; color: #26705e; background: #eef7f3; font: 700 8px/1 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-chip i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #197b72; }

narrative.overview:
The interface takes its cues from a focused investigation desk: restrained institutional navy, warm paper surfaces, measured amber emphasis, and compact metadata that keeps timestamps and provenance close to the evidence. The Rajasthan Police inspiration is expressed through a professional control-room tone; this is a prototype and does not represent an official system.

The dashboard is information-dense but keeps each action legible. Candidate frames and clip details remain the center of attention, while status colors carry clear meaning. Synthetic evidence and local-only processing are labeled directly in the product.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, operational hierarchy with compact, scannable labels.
Warm paper and sand surfaces against a deep navy rail.
Human-reviewed evidence, provenance, and confidence qualifiers stay visible.

rules.name: The Meaningful Status Rule
rules.body: Amber, teal, and red communicate a review state; do not use them as decoration.

rules.name: The Provenance Readability Rule
rules.body: Hashes and event identifiers use monospace with tabular numerals; explanatory copy stays in the body face.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep resting panels flat and calm; reserve stronger depth for a surfaced interaction.

dos: Do keep event time, camera/channel, and source provenance beside evidence.
Do use status colors consistently and pair warnings with text.
Do preserve the current compact, readable control-room hierarchy.
Do keep synthetic/sample labels visible in the interface.
donts: Don't imply official Rajasthan Police endorsement or use unprovided government insignia.
Don't present visual similarity or a detector result as a confirmed identity.
Don't style recorded uploaded clips as live bank CCTV.
Don't use amber, teal, or red for decoration.
